<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

# vec.js API Documentation

This document describes the vector mathematics functions available in vec.js.

## Functions

### add(a, b)
Adds two vectors together.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the sum

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### sub(a, b)
Subtracts the second vector from the first.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the difference

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### len(v)
Calculates the length (magnitude) of a vector.

**Parameters:**
- `v` (object): Vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**

# vec.js API Documentation

This document describes the vector mathematics functions available in vec.js.

## Functions

### add(a, b)
Adds two vectors together.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the sum

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### sub(a, b)
Subtracts the second vector from the first.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the difference

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### len(v)
Calculates the length (magnitude) of a vector.

**Parameters:**
- `v` (object): Vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (number): The length of the vector

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

This is a simple 2D collection game built with Phaser 3. The player controls a character to collect coins while avoiding obstacles. The game ends when all coins are collected.

- Game resolution: 800x600 pixels

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>

# vec.js API Documentation

This document describes the vector mathematics functions available in vec.js.

## Functions

### add(a, b)
Adds two vectors together.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the sum

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### sub(a, b)
Subtracts the second vector from the first.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the difference

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### len(v)
Calculates the length (magnitude) of a vector.

**Parameters:**
- `v` (object): Vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (number): The length of the vector

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);

# utils.js Documentation

This file documents all the utility functions available in utils.js.

## clamp(v, lo, hi)

Restricts a value between low and high bounds.

**Parameters:**
- `v` (number): The value to clamp
- `lo` (number): The lower bound
- `hi` (number): The upper bound

**Returns:**
- number: The clamped value (between lo and hi)

**Throws:**
- Error: If any argument is not a number
- Error: If lower bound is greater than upper bound

**Example:**
```javascript
clamp(5, 1, 10);  // Returns 5
clamp(0, 1, 10);  // Returns 1
clamp(15, 1, 10); // Returns 10
```

## randInt(lo, hi)

Generates a random integer between low and high (inclusive).

**Parameters:**
- `lo` (number): The lower bound (inclusive)
- `hi` (number): The upper bound (inclusive)

**Returns:**
- number: A random integer between lo and hi (inclusive)

**Throws:**
- Error: If any argument is not a number
- Error: If lower bound is greater than upper bound

**Example:**
```javascript
randInt(1, 6);    // Returns a random integer between 1 and 6 (inclusive)
randInt(10, 20);  // Returns a random integer between 10 and 20 (inclusive)
```

## lerp(a, b, t)

Performs linear interpolation between two values.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (number): The start value
- `b` (number): The end value
- `t` (number): The interpolation parameter (should be between 0 and 1)

**Returns:**
- number: The interpolated value

**Throws:**
- Error: If any argument is not a number
- Error: If t is not between 0 and 1

**Example:**
```javascript
lerp(0, 10, 0.5);  // Returns 5
lerp(10, 20, 0.25); // Returns 12.5
```

## Overview
This is a simple 2D collection game built with Phaser 3. The player controls a character to collect coins while avoiding obstacles. The game ends when all coins are collected.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move up
  - Down Arrow: Move down
  - Left Arrow: Move left
  - Right Arrow: Move right

## Assets Used

- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Coin collectible sprites

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collect coins to increase score
- All coins must be collected to win
- Game ends when all coins are collected

## Scoring System
- Each coin collected gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner
- When all coins are collected, "You Win!" message appears with final score

## Game Flow
1. Player starts at center of screen
2. Coins are randomly positioned throughout the game world
3. Player collects coins by moving over them
4. Game ends when all coins are collected
5. Win screen shows final score

## Technical Details
- Game resolution: 800x600 pixels
- Physics: Arcade physics with no gravity
- Collision detection: Player vs Coin group
- Game state: Single scene with preload, create, and update functions

    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

- Score updates in real-time as items are collected

# vec.js API Documentation

This document describes the vector mathematics functions available in vec.js.

## Functions

### add(a, b)
Adds two vectors together.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the sum

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### sub(a, b)
Subtracts the second vector from the first.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the difference

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### len(v)
Calculates the length (magnitude) of a vector.

**Parameters:**

try:

    try:

        assert result["x"] == 4 and result["y"] == 6
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 1 failed: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Test 2: Missing x property in first argument
    try:
        result = add({"y": 2}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 2 failed: Should have thrown error for missing x in first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 2 passed: Correctly threw error for missing x in first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 3: Missing y property in first argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 3 failed: Should have thrown error for missing y in first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 3 passed: Correctly threw error for missing y in first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 4: Missing x property in second argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, {"y": 4})
        print("Test 4 failed: Should have thrown error for missing x in second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 4 passed: Correctly threw error for missing x in second argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 5: Missing y property in second argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, {"x": 3})
        print("Test 5 failed: Should have thrown error for missing y in second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 5 passed: Correctly threw error for missing y in second argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 6: Undefined first argument
    try:
        result = add(None, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 6 failed: Should have thrown error for undefined first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 6 passed: Correctly threw error for undefined first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 7: Undefined second argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, None)
        print("Test 7 failed: Should have thrown error for undefined second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 7 passed: Correctly threw error for undefined second argument: {e}")
        
    print("All tests passed!")
    
except ImportError as e:
    print(f"Failed to import vec module: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

# Phaser 3 Collection Game

## Overview
This is a simple collection game built with Phaser 3 where the player controls a character to collect items. The game features keyboard controls, collision detection, scoring, and win conditions.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move player up
  - Down Arrow: Move player down
  - Left Arrow: Move player left
  - Right Arrow: Move player right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets by path:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Collectible item sprite

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collectible items (coins) appear at fixed positions
- Collision detection between player and collectibles
- Each collected item increases the score by 10 points
- Game ends when all collectibles are collected
- Win condition: Collect all items to win the game

## Scoring System
- Each collectible item gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner of the screen
- When all items are collected, "You Win! Score: X" is displayed

## Game States
- **Playing**: Player can move and collect items
- **Win**: All items collected, win message displayed
- **Lose**: Not applicable in this implementation (no time limit or lives)

## Implementation Details
- Uses Phaser 3 with Arcade Physics
- Player character has world bounds collision
- Collectibles are created in fixed positions (100,100), (200,200), (300,300)
- Physics overlap detection handles item collection
- Score updates in real-time as items are collected

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

import sys
import os
sys.path.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

try:
    from vec import add

    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 1 passed: Normal addition works")
        assert result["x"] == 4 and result["y"] == 6
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 1 failed: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Test 2: Missing x property in first argument
    try:
        result = add({"y": 2}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 2 failed: Should have thrown error for missing x in first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 2 passed: Correctly threw error for missing x in first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 3: Missing y property in first argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 3 failed: Should have thrown error for missing y in first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 3 passed: Correctly threw error for missing y in first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 4: Missing x property in second argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, {"y": 4})
        print("Test 4 failed: Should have thrown error for missing x in second argument")

    except Exception as e:

    # Test 5: Missing y property in second argument

        print("Test 5 failed: Should have thrown error for missing y in second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 5 passed: Correctly threw error for missing y in second argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 6: Undefined first argument
    try:
        result = add(None, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 6 failed: Should have thrown error for undefined first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 6 passed: Correctly threw error for undefined first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 7: Undefined second argument

        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, None)
        print("Test 7 failed: Should have thrown error for undefined second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 7 passed: Correctly threw error for undefined second argument: {e}")
        
    print("All tests passed!")
    
except ImportError as e:

    sys.exit(1)
except Exception as e:

    sys.exit(1)

- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### len(v)
Calculates the length (magnitude) of a vector.

**Parameters:**
- `v` (object): Vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (number): The length of the vector

import sys
import os
sys.path.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

try:
    from vec import add
    
    # Test 1: Normal operation should work
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 1 passed: Normal addition works")
        assert result["x"] == 4 and result["y"] == 6
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 1 failed: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Test 2: Missing x property in first argument
    try:
        result = add({"y": 2}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 2 failed: Should have thrown error for missing x in first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 2 passed: Correctly threw error for missing x in first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 3: Missing y property in first argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1}, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 3 failed: Should have thrown error for missing y in first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 3 passed: Correctly threw error for missing y in first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 4: Missing x property in second argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, {"y": 4})
        print("Test 4 failed: Should have thrown error for missing x in second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 4 passed: Correctly threw error for missing x in second argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 5: Missing y property in second argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, {"x": 3})
        print("Test 5 failed: Should have thrown error for missing y in second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 5 passed: Correctly threw error for missing y in second argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 6: Undefined first argument
    try:
        result = add(None, {"x": 3, "y": 4})
        print("Test 6 failed: Should have thrown error for undefined first argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 6 passed: Correctly threw error for undefined first argument: {e}")
    
    # Test 7: Undefined second argument
    try:
        result = add({"x": 1, "y": 2}, None)
        print("Test 7 failed: Should have thrown error for undefined second argument")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test 7 passed: Correctly threw error for undefined second argument: {e}")
        
    print("All tests passed!")
    
except ImportError as e:
    print(f"Failed to import vec module: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

## mathx.js

### `add(a, b)`
Adds two numbers together.

### `mul(a, b)`
Multiplies two numbers together.

### `clamp(value, min, max)`
Clamps a value between a minimum and maximum.

### `lerp(start, end, t)`
Linearly interpolates between start and end by factor t.

### `sign(value)`
Returns the sign of a number (1 for positive, -1 for negative, 0 for zero).

### `avg(numbers)`
Calculates the average of an array of numbers.

### `sum(numbers)`
Calculates the sum of an array of numbers.

### `min2(a, b)`
Returns the smaller of two numbers.

### `max2(a, b)`
Returns the larger of two numbers.

### `sq(value)`
Returns the square of a number.

### `cube(value)`
Returns the cube of a number.

### `isEven(value)`
Checks if a number is even.

## strx.js

### `slug(s)`
Converts a string to a URL-friendly slug (lowercase, spaces to dashes).

### `title(s)`
Converts a string to title case (capitalize each word).

# Game Documentation

## Overview
This is a simple 2D collection game built with Phaser 3. The player controls a character to collect coins while avoiding obstacles. The game ends when all coins are collected.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move up
  - Down Arrow: Move down
  - Left Arrow: Move left
  - Right Arrow: Move right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Coin collectible sprites

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collect coins to increase score
- All coins must be collected to win
- Game ends when all coins are collected

## Scoring System
- Each coin collected gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner
- When all coins are collected, "You Win!" message appears with final score

## Game Flow
1. Player starts at center of screen
2. Coins are randomly positioned throughout the game world
3. Player collects coins by moving over them
4. Game ends when all coins are collected
5. Win screen shows final score

## Technical Details
- Game resolution: 800x600 pixels
- Physics: Arcade physics with no gravity
- Collision detection: Player vs Coin group
- Game state: Single scene with preload, create, and update functions

# P1 Documentation

## Functions

### add(a, b)
- **Description**: Adds two numbers.
- **Parameters**:
  - `a`: First number (must be a number).
  - `b`: Second number (must be a number).
- **Returns**: The sum of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### mul(a, b)
- **Description**: Multiplies two numbers.
- **Parameters**:
  - `a`: First number (must be a number).
  - `b`: Second number (must be a number).
- **Returns**: The product of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### sub(a, b)
- **Description**: Subtracts the second number from the first.
- **Parameters**:
  - `a`: First number (must be a number).
  - `b`: Second number (must be a number).
- **Returns**: The difference between `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

# P1.md

## Functions in p1_calc.js

### add(a, b)
- **Description**: Adds two numbers.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The sum of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### mul(a, b)
- **Description**: Multiplies two numbers.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The product of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### sub(a, b)
- **Description**: Subtracts the second number from the first.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The result of `a` minus `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### div(a, b)
- **Description**: Divides the first number by the second.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The result of `a` divided by `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.
  - Error if `b` is zero (division by zero is not allowed).

# Game Documentation

## Overview
This is a simple 2D collection game built with Phaser 3. The player controls a character to collect coins while avoiding obstacles. The game ends when all coins are collected.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move up
  - Down Arrow: Move down
  - Left Arrow: Move left
  - Right Arrow: Move right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Coin collectible sprites

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collect coins to increase score
- All coins must be collected to win
- Game ends when all coins are collected

## Scoring System
- Each coin collected gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner
- When all coins are collected, "You Win!" message appears with final score

## Game Flow
1. Player starts at center of screen
2. Coins are randomly positioned throughout the game world
3. Player collects coins by moving over them
4. Game ends when all coins are collected
5. Win screen shows final score

## Technical Details
- Game resolution: 800x600 pixels
- Physics: Arcade physics with no gravity
- Collision detection: Player vs Coin group
- Game state: Single scene with preload, create, and update functions

# Phaser 3 Collection Game

## Overview
This is a simple collection game built with Phaser 3 where the player controls a character to collect items. The game features keyboard controls, collision detection, scoring, and win conditions.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move player up
  - Down Arrow: Move player down
  - Left Arrow: Move player left
  - Right Arrow: Move player right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets by path:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Collectible item sprite

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collectible items (coins) appear at fixed positions
- Collision detection between player and collectibles
- Each collected item increases the score by 10 points
- Game ends when all collectibles are collected
- Win condition: Collect all items to win the game

## Scoring System
- Each collectible item gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner of the screen
- When all items are collected, "You Win! Score: X" is displayed

## Game States
- **Playing**: Player can move and collect items
- **Win**: All items collected, win message displayed
- **Lose**: Not applicable in this implementation (no time limit or lives)

## Implementation Details
- Uses Phaser 3 with Arcade Physics
- Player character has world bounds collision
- Collectibles are created in fixed positions (100,100), (200,200), (300,300)
- Physics overlap detection handles item collection
- Score updates in real-time as items are collected

# Game Documentation

## Overview
This is a simple 2D collection game built with Phaser 3. The player controls a character to collect coins while avoiding obstacles. The game ends when all coins are collected.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move up
  - Down Arrow: Move down
  - Left Arrow: Move left
  - Right Arrow: Move right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Coin collectible sprites

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collect coins to increase score
- All coins must be collected to win
- Game ends when all coins are collected

## Scoring System
- Each coin collected gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner
- When all coins are collected, "You Win!" message appears with final score

## Game Flow
1. Player starts at center of screen
2. Coins are randomly positioned throughout the game world
3. Player collects coins by moving over them
4. Game ends when all coins are collected
5. Win screen shows final score

## Technical Details
- Game resolution: 800x600 pixels
- Physics: Arcade physics with no gravity
- Collision detection: Player vs Coin group
- Game state: Single scene with preload, create, and update functions

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

# Game Documentation

## Overview
This is a simple 2D collection game built with Phaser 3. The player controls a character to collect coins while avoiding obstacles. The game ends when all coins are collected.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move up
  - Down Arrow: Move down
  - Left Arrow: Move left
  - Right Arrow: Move right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Coin collectible sprites

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collect coins to increase score
- All coins must be collected to win
- Game ends when all coins are collected

## Scoring System
- Each coin collected gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner
- When all coins are collected, "You Win!" message appears with final score

## Game Flow
1. Player starts at center of screen
2. Coins are randomly positioned throughout the game world
3. Player collects coins by moving over them
4. Game ends when all coins are collected
5. Win screen shows final score

## Technical Details
- Game resolution: 800x600 pixels
- Physics: Arcade physics with no gravity
- Collision detection: Player vs Coin group
- Game state: Single scene with preload, create, and update functions

# Phaser 3 Collection Game

## Overview
This is a simple collection game built with Phaser 3 where the player controls a character to collect items. The game features keyboard controls, collision detection, scoring, and win conditions.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move player up
  - Down Arrow: Move player down
  - Left Arrow: Move player left
  - Right Arrow: Move player right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets by path:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Collectible item sprite

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collectible items (coins) appear at fixed positions
- Collision detection between player and collectibles
- Each collected item increases the score by 10 points
- Game ends when all collectibles are collected
- Win condition: Collect all items to win the game

## Scoring System
- Each collectible item gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner of the screen
- When all items are collected, "You Win! Score: X" is displayed

## Game States
- **Playing**: Player can move and collect items
- **Win**: All items collected, win message displayed
- **Lose**: Not applicable in this implementation (no time limit or lives)

## Implementation Details
- Uses Phaser 3 with Arcade Physics
- Player character has world bounds collision
- Collectibles are created in fixed positions (100,100), (200,200), (300,300)
- Physics overlap detection handles item collection
- Score updates in real-time as items are collected

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

# P1.md

## Functions in p1_calc.js

### add(a, b)
- **Description**: Adds two numbers.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The sum of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### mul(a, b)
- **Description**: Multiplies two numbers.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The product of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### sub(a, b)
- **Description**: Subtracts the second number from the first.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The result of `a` minus `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### div(a, b)
- **Description**: Divides the first number by the second.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The result of `a` divided by `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.
  - Error if `b` is zero (division by zero is not allowed).

# Phaser 3 Collection Game

## Overview
This is a simple collection game built with Phaser 3 where the player controls a character to collect items. The game features keyboard controls, collision detection, scoring, and win conditions.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move player up
  - Down Arrow: Move player down
  - Left Arrow: Move player left
  - Right Arrow: Move player right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets by path:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Collectible item sprite

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collectible items (coins) appear at fixed positions
- Collision detection between player and collectibles
- Each collected item increases the score by 10 points
- Game ends when all collectibles are collected
- Win condition: Collect all items to win the game

## Scoring System
- Each collectible item gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner of the screen
- When all items are collected, "You Win! Score: X" is displayed

## Game States
- **Playing**: Player can move and collect items
- **Win**: All items collected, win message displayed
- **Lose**: Not applicable in this implementation (no time limit or lives)

## Implementation Details
- Uses Phaser 3 with Arcade Physics
- Player character has world bounds collision
- Collectibles are created in fixed positions (100,100), (200,200), (300,300)
- Physics overlap detection handles item collection
- Score updates in real-time as items are collected

# Phaser 3 Collection Game

## Overview
This is a simple collection game built with Phaser 3 where the player controls a character to collect items. The game features keyboard controls, collision detection, scoring, and win conditions.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move player up
  - Down Arrow: Move player down
  - Left Arrow: Move player left
  - Right Arrow: Move player right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets by path:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Collectible item sprite

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collectible items (coins) appear at fixed positions
- Collision detection between player and collectibles
- Each collected item increases the score by 10 points
- Game ends when all collectibles are collected
- Win condition: Collect all items to win the game

## Scoring System
- Each collectible item gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner of the screen
- When all items are collected, "You Win! Score: X" is displayed

## Game States
- **Playing**: Player can move and collect items
- **Win**: All items collected, win message displayed
- **Lose**: Not applicable in this implementation (no time limit or lives)

## Implementation Details
- Uses Phaser 3 with Arcade Physics
- Player character has world bounds collision
- Collectibles are created in fixed positions (100,100), (200,200), (300,300)
- Physics overlap detection handles item collection
- Score updates in real-time as items are collected

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }

        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>

## Functions in p1_calc.js

### add(a, b)
- **Description**: Adds two numbers.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The sum of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### mul(a, b)
- **Description**: Multiplies two numbers.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The product of `a` and `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### sub(a, b)
- **Description**: Subtracts the second number from the first.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The result of `a` minus `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.

### div(a, b)
- **Description**: Divides the first number by the second.
- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.
- **Returns**: The result of `a` divided by `b`.
- **Throws**: 
  - Error if either `a` or `b` is not a number.
  - Error if `b` is zero (division by zero is not allowed).

# Phaser 3 Collection Game

## Overview
This is a simple collection game built with Phaser 3 where the player controls a character to collect items. The game features keyboard controls, collision detection, scoring, and win conditions.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move player up
  - Down Arrow: Move player down
  - Left Arrow: Move player left
  - Right Arrow: Move player right

## Assets Used
The game loads the following assets by path:
- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Collectible item sprite

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collectible items (coins) appear at fixed positions
- Collision detection between player and collectibles
- Each collected item increases the score by 10 points
- Game ends when all collectibles are collected
- Win condition: Collect all items to win the game

## Scoring System
- Each collectible item gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner of the screen
- When all items are collected, "You Win! Score: X" is displayed

## Game States
- **Playing**: Player can move and collect items
- **Win**: All items collected, win message displayed
- **Lose**: Not applicable in this implementation (no time limit or lives)

## Implementation Details
- Uses Phaser 3 with Arcade Physics
- Player character has world bounds collision
- Collectibles are created in fixed positions (100,100), (200,200), (300,300)
- Physics overlap detection handles item collection
- Score updates in real-time as items are collected

# vec.js API Documentation

This document describes the vector mathematics functions available in vec.js.

## Functions

### add(a, b)
Adds two vectors together.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the sum

**Throws:**

# Game Documentation

## Overview
This is a simple 2D collection game built with Phaser 3. The player controls a character to collect coins while avoiding obstacles. The game ends when all coins are collected.

## Controls
- **Arrow Keys**: Move the player character
  - Up Arrow: Move up
  - Down Arrow: Move down
  - Left Arrow: Move left
  - Right Arrow: Move right

## Assets Used

- `assets/player.png` - Player character sprite
- `assets/coin.png` - Coin collectible sprites

## Game Mechanics
- Player character moves with arrow keys
- Collect coins to increase score
- All coins must be collected to win
- Game ends when all coins are collected

## Scoring System
- Each coin collected gives 10 points
- Score is displayed in the top-left corner
- When all coins are collected, "You Win!" message appears with final score

## Game Flow
1. Player starts at center of screen
2. Coins are randomly positioned throughout the game world
3. Player collects coins by moving over them
4. Game ends when all coins are collected
5. Win screen shows final score

## Technical Details
- Game resolution: 800x600 pixels
- Physics: Arcade physics with no gravity
- Collision detection: Player vs Coin group
- Game state: Single scene with preload, create, and update functions

# utils.js Documentation

This file documents all the utility functions available in utils.js.

## clamp(v, lo, hi)

Restricts a value between low and high bounds.

**Parameters:**
- `v` (number): The value to clamp
- `lo` (number): The lower bound
- `hi` (number): The upper bound

**Returns:**
- number: The clamped value (between lo and hi)

**Throws:**
- Error: If any argument is not a number
- Error: If lower bound is greater than upper bound

**Example:**
```javascript
clamp(5, 1, 10);  // Returns 5
clamp(0, 1, 10);  // Returns 1
clamp(15, 1, 10); // Returns 10
```

## randInt(lo, hi)

Generates a random integer between low and high (inclusive).

**Parameters:**
- `lo` (number): The lower bound (inclusive)
- `hi` (number): The upper bound (inclusive)

**Returns:**
- number: A random integer between lo and hi (inclusive)

**Throws:**
- Error: If any argument is not a number
- Error: If lower bound is greater than upper bound

**Example:**
```javascript
randInt(1, 6);    // Returns a random integer between 1 and 6 (inclusive)
randInt(10, 20);  // Returns a random integer between 10 and 20 (inclusive)
```

## lerp(a, b, t)

Performs linear interpolation between two values.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (number): The start value
- `b` (number): The end value
- `t` (number): The interpolation parameter (should be between 0 and 1)

**Returns:**
- number: The interpolated value

**Throws:**
- Error: If any argument is not a number
- Error: If t is not between 0 and 1

**Example:**
```javascript
lerp(0, 10, 0.5);  // Returns 5
lerp(10, 20, 0.25); // Returns 12.5
```

# vec.js API Documentation

This document describes the vector mathematics functions available in vec.js.

## Functions

### add(a, b)
Adds two vectors together.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the sum

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### sub(a, b)
Subtracts the second vector from the first.

**Parameters:**
- `a` (object): First vector with `x` and `y` properties
- `b` (object): Second vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (object): A new vector with `x` and `y` properties representing the difference

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If first argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)
- `Error`: If second argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

### len(v)
Calculates the length (magnitude) of a vector.

**Parameters:**
- `v` (object): Vector with `x` and `y` properties

**Returns:**
- (number): The length of the vector

**Throws:**
- `Error`: If argument is not a valid vector (missing x/y properties or not an object)

- **Parameters**:

- **Returns**: The result of `a` minus `b`.
- **Throws**:

- **Parameters**: 
  - `a` (number): The first number.
  - `b` (number): The second number.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Phaser 3 Game</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.60.0/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Game configuration
        const config = {
            type: Phaser.AUTO,
            width: 800,
            height: 600,
            physics: {
                default: 'arcade',
                arcade: {
                    gravity: { y: 0 },
                    debug: false
                }
            },
            scene: {
                preload: preload,
                create: create,
                update: update
            }
        };

        // Game variables
        let player;
        let cursors;
        let collectibles;
        let score = 0;
        let scoreText;
        let gameWon = false;

        // Create the game
        const game = new Phaser.Game(config);

        function preload() {
            // Load assets
            this.load.image('player', 'assets/player.png');
            this.load.image('collectible', 'assets/coin.png');
        }

        function create() {
            // Create player
            player = this.physics.add.sprite(400, 300, 'player');
            player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);

            // Create collectibles
            collectibles = this.physics.add.group();
            collectibles.create(100, 100, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(200, 200, 'collectible');
            collectibles.create(300, 300, 'collectible');

            // Set up keyboard input
            cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();

            // Create score text
            scoreText = this.add.text(16, 16, 'Score: 0', { fontSize: '32px', fill: '#000' });

            // Set up collision detection
            this.physics.add.overlap(player, collectibles, collectItem, null, this);
        }

        function update() {
            // Player movement
            if (cursors.left.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(-160);
            } else if (cursors.right.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityX(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityX(0);
            }

            if (cursors.up.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(-160);
            } else if (cursors.down.isDown) {
                player.setVelocityY(160);
            } else {
                player.setVelocityY(0);
            }
        }

        function collectItem(player, collectible) {
            // Remove the collectible from the game
            collectible.disableBody(true, true);
            
            // Update score
            score += 10;
            scoreText.setText('Score: ' + score);
            
            // Check if all collectibles are collected
            if (collectibles.countActive(true) === 0) {
                // Game won
                gameWon = true;
                scoreText.setText('You Win! Score: ' + score);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
